facts.statement: frontend-proxy p95 latency is 15000 ms and its error ratio is 0.34; frontend is at 15000 ms p95 with an error ratio of 0.30. Both are the only services in the alarm range; checkout, product-catalog and the others are normal.
frontend's latency and error ratio rose first, at about 19:25; frontend-proxy followed within a minute.
frontend's error logs are 200 lines of one message: 'API request failed', 14 UNAVAILABLE, connect ETIMEDOUT 10.96.2.177:9999, HTTP 500, first seen 19:26:11.
Error spans in frontend are on oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct with the same ETIMEDOUT message to 10.96.2.177:9999, plus HTTP 500s on /api/products and /api/recommendations.
frontend rollout revision 2 was created at 19:23:30 with change-cause 'frontend config release: catalog client moved to port 9999'. Revision 1 was created at 19:10:45.
The diff from revision 1 to 2 is exactly one change: PRODUCT_CATALOG_ADDR from product-catalog:8080 to product-catalog:9999.
frontend's client spans show GetProduct STATUS_CODE_ERROR at about 4-7 per second from 19:26:54 onward, while GetProduct UNSET (success) drops to 0 by about 19:22-19:27.
product-catalog logs are info-only ('Product Found', 'Found 10 products from database') with no errors in the last 30 minutes, and its p95 is 8.55 ms.
All feature flags are off, so no flag change explains the incident.
Kubernetes events show a normal frontend pod replacement at 19:23:30-19:23:31 and no crash or OOM events for product-catalog. Unrelated probe warnings are on the collector, alertmanager and loki.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check the product-catalog Service's ports and endpoints in otel-demo; confirm the container listens on 8080 and not 9999.
hypotheses.statement: Nothing listens on port 9999 in the product-catalog Service or pod, so the port in the frontend config is simply wrong (should be 8080).

hypotheses.how_to_verify: After rollback, confirm service:sli_error_ratio:rate5m for frontend and frontend-proxy falls toward zero.
hypotheses.statement: The rollback to revision 1 restores the error rate and latency within a few minutes.

inferences.statement: The frontend revision 2 port change to 9999 is the trigger: the timeouts go to 9999, which product-catalog does not serve on its own side (its logs and metrics show normal serving on the old path). The alert's 15 s latency is the caller's timeout behavior.
The error onset at about 19:26 lags the 19:23:30 rollout by about 3 minutes; this could be low traffic on the new pod or retry timing, and it does not change the attribution.

root_causes.cause: Config release at 19:23:30 (revision 2) pointed PRODUCT_CATALOG_ADDR at product-catalog:9999 instead of product-catalog:8080. Connections to the catalog on 9999 time out, so GetProduct and recommendation lookups fail with gRPC UNAVAILABLE and HTTP 500. Roll back frontend to revision 1 or correct the port.

diagnosis.summary: frontend-proxy p95 is at the 15s cap with a 34% error ratio because frontend fails its ProductCatalogService calls. At 19:23:30 frontend was redeployed (revision 2, 'catalog client moved to port 9999'), which changed PRODUCT_CATALOG_ADDR from product-catalog:8080 to product-catalog:9999. Frontend's calls to 10.96.2.177:9999 now time out (connect ETIMEDOUT), returning HTTP 500 and dragging frontend-proxy down with it. product-catalog itself shows normal latency and info-only logs, so the fault is the frontend configuration change, not the catalog service.
